api-endpoints.description: RESTful API endpoint definitions using FastAPI routers

required_patterns.router-definition: Must use APIRouter with prefix and tags for endpoint grouping
required_patterns.dependency-injection: Must use Depends() for database sessions and other dependencies
required_patterns.async-handlers: All endpoint handlers must be async functions
required_patterns.response-models: Must specify response_model using Pydantic schemas
required_patterns.http-status-codes: Must use appropriate HTTP status codes from fastapi.status
required_patterns.error-handling: Must raise HTTPException for error cases with appropriate status codes
required_patterns.query-parameters: Must use Query() for query parameter validation with defaults and constraints
required_patterns.documentation: Must include comprehensive docstrings with Args, Returns, and Raises sections

architectural_constraints.separation-of-concerns: Endpoints must not contain business logic - delegate to CRUD layer
architectural_constraints.database-access: Must use get_db dependency, never create sessions directly
architectural_constraints.validation: All input/output must use Pydantic schemas from app.schemas
architectural_constraints.crud-delegation: All database operations must go through app.crud functions

database.description: Database models, session management, and migrations using SQLAlchemy and Alembic

required_patterns.model-definition: Must inherit from Base and use SQLAlchemy 2.0 style with Mapped and mapped_column
required_patterns.async-sessions: All database operations must use AsyncSession
required_patterns.uuid-ids: Primary keys must be UUID strings (using uuid.uuid4())
required_patterns.timestamps: Models should include created_at and updated_at DateTime fields
required_patterns.type-annotations: Must use Mapped[] type hints for all columns
required_patterns.migrations: All schema changes must be done through Alembic migrations

architectural_constraints.no-raw-sql: Must use SQLAlchemy ORM, not raw SQL queries
architectural_constraints.migration-required: Never modify models without creating corresponding Alembic migration
architectural_constraints.session-lifecycle: Sessions managed by dependency injection, never create manually in endpoints

data-layer.description: CRUD operations layer that abstracts database access from API endpoints

required_patterns.crud-module: All database operations must be in app/crud.py (or app/crud/ directory for larger apps)
required_patterns.async-functions: All CRUD functions must be async
required_patterns.session-parameter: All CRUD functions must accept AsyncSession as first parameter
required_patterns.return-types: Must use clear return type annotations (Model | None, Sequence[Model], bool, int)
required_patterns.error-handling: Return None for not found, let caller decide on exception handling
required_patterns.comprehensive-docs: Must include docstrings with Args and Returns sections

architectural_constraints.no-exceptions: CRUD layer should not raise HTTP exceptions (that's for endpoints)
architectural_constraints.atomic-operations: Use flush() instead of commit() - commits handled by dependency
architectural_constraints.refresh-pattern: After flush, use refresh() to get DB-generated values

required_patterns.base-schema: Use inheritance with Base schema for shared attributes
required_patterns.field-validation: Use Field() with constraints (min_length, max_length, description)
required_patterns.create-update-pattern: Separate schemas for Create (required fields) and Update (optional fields)
required_patterns.response-schema: Separate response schema that matches database model
required_patterns.model-config: Use ConfigDict for Pydantic v2 configuration
required_patterns.type-hints: Use modern Python type hints (str | None instead of Optional[str])

architectural_constraints.no-orm-in-schemas: Schemas should not import database models
architectural_constraints.validate-at-boundary: All API inputs must be validated through Pydantic schemas

state-management.description: Client-side server state management using React Query (@tanstack/react-query)

required_patterns.query-hooks: Create custom hooks for all queries (useTodos, useTodo)
required_patterns.mutation-hooks: Create custom hooks for all mutations (useCreateTodo, useUpdateTodo, useDeleteTodo)
required_patterns.optimistic-updates: Use onSuccess callbacks to update cache for immediate UI feedback
required_patterns.cache-manipulation: Use setQueryData to update cache after mutations

architectural_constraints.no-local-state-for-server-data: Never use useState for data that comes from the server
architectural_constraints.centralized-queries: All React Query hooks must be in services/queries.ts
architectural_constraints.api-separation: Query hooks call functions from services/api.ts, never make fetch calls directly
architectural_constraints.cache-invalidation: Use setQueryData for updates, not invalidateQueries (for better UX)

ui.description: React components using TypeScript, Next.js App Router, and Tailwind CSS

required_patterns.typescript: All components must use TypeScript with proper type annotations
required_patterns.client-components: Interactive components must use 'use client' directive
required_patterns.props-interface: Define interface for component props with JSDoc comments
required_patterns.tailwind-styling: Use Tailwind utility classes for styling (no CSS modules)
required_patterns.component-docs: Include JSDoc comment describing component purpose and props
required_patterns.accessibility: Use semantic HTML and proper ARIA attributes

architectural_constraints.component-location: Reusable components in components/, pages in app/
architectural_constraints.no-inline-styles: Never use style prop, use Tailwind classes
architectural_constraints.no-css-files-per-component: All styling via Tailwind, no component-specific CSS files
architectural_constraints.app-router: Use Next.js App Router structure (not Pages Router)

required_patterns.use-form-hook: Must use useForm hook for form state management
required_patterns.handle-submit: Use handleSubmit wrapper for form submission
required_patterns.validation-rules: Define validation rules in register() call (required, minLength, maxLength, validate)
required_patterns.controlled-components: Use register pattern, not controlled components with useState

architectural_constraints.no-manual-state: Never use useState to manage form field values
architectural_constraints.validation-in-register: Validation rules must be in register(), not separate logic
architectural_constraints.mutation-integration: Integrate with React Query mutations for server submission

required_patterns.motion-components: Use motion.div, motion.button instead of regular HTML elements
required_patterns.animation-variants: Define animation states for complex animations
required_patterns.layout-animations: Use layout prop for automatic layout animations

architectural_constraints.performance: Use transform and opacity for performant animations

testing.description: Comprehensive testing strategy with pytest (backend), jest (frontend unit), and playwright (E2E)

required_patterns.backend-testing: Use pytest with pytest-asyncio for async tests
required_patterns.in-memory-db: Backend tests use SQLite in-memory database
required_patterns.test-fixtures: Use pytest fixtures for test setup (db_session, client)
required_patterns.test-helpers: Create reusable helpers for common test operations
required_patterns.descriptive-names: Test function names should clearly describe what is being tested

architectural_constraints.isolated-tests: Each test must be independent and not rely on other tests
architectural_constraints.mock-external-services: Mock external dependencies, never hit real external services
architectural_constraints.test-coverage: Maintain high test coverage for critical paths
architectural_constraints.test-organization: Backend tests in tests/, frontend tests in __tests/, E2E in e2e/

required_patterns.utility-classes: Use Tailwind utility classes for all styling
required_patterns.responsive-design: Use Tailwind responsive prefixes (sm:, md:, lg:)
required_patterns.color-scheme: Use Tailwind color palette (gray-*, blue-*, etc.)
required_patterns.spacing-scale: Use Tailwind spacing scale (px-4, py-3, mb-8)
required_patterns.transitions: Use transition-* utilities for smooth state changes

architectural_constraints.no-custom-css: Avoid custom CSS classes unless necessary for complex animations
architectural_constraints.design-tokens: Use Tailwind config for custom design tokens, not inline values

configuration.description: Environment-based configuration using pydantic-settings (backend) and Next.js env vars (frontend)

required_patterns.backend-config: Use pydantic-settings BaseSettings class for configuration
required_patterns.env-files: Store sensitive config in .env files, not in code
required_patterns.frontend-env: Use NEXT_PUBLIC_ prefix for client-side environment variables
required_patterns.type-safe-config: All configuration values must be type-annotated

architectural_constraints.no-hardcoded-urls: Never hardcode URLs or API endpoints
architectural_constraints.environment-specific: Support different configs for development, testing, production
architectural_constraints.secrets-management: Never commit secrets or API keys to version control
